newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian nuclear power plants had good 1996.
newsitem.headline: Belgian nuclear power plants had good 1996.

text.p: Belgium's two nuclear power plants at Doel and Tihange generated 41.2 billion kilowatt hours of electricity or 54.8 percent of the power generated in Belgium last year, utility Electrabel said on Monday.
It said the load factor of all the plants combined was 82.5 percent despite the closure for 91 days during the summer of unit four at Doel for the replacement of three steam generators.
Electrabel said the results showed that Belgium's power nuclear plants were among the best performing units in the world.
